HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

   B. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

3. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain External Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
